note: Alberta Parks PRA campground run by the Fox Creek Development Association for West Fraser, about 25 km SW of Hinton off Hwy 16 and 5 km of gravel; three of its 22 sites are walk-in tent sites. Pier and two small day-use areas; non-motorized or electric-powered boats only; free firewood. An Alberta Parks low-water advisory for the boat launch (since April 23, 2024) says the floating dock sits in very shallow water on muddy ground. Kinky Lake campground in the same PRA is a separate entry. --Claude
